summary: John's 8th-great-grandfather; Kirchenzensor (church elder) of Jettenbach from 1700 - the earliest Grub at Jettenbach.
bio: Baptized 28 Feb 1655 at Berschweiler; married 19 Oct 1694 at Glan-Münchweiler; Kirchenzensor (church elder) at Jettenbach from 1700; died at Jettenbach 15 Oct 1739. The family moved from Oberbrombach to Berschweiler to Jettenbach in the generations after the Thirty Years' War.
sources: GEDBAS file 53093 ('Helf-Maier', compiled by Karl-Hans Helf; Jettenbach Grubs; Lutheran parish; sources not displayed), person 1193191772: https://gedbas.genealogy.net/person/show/1193191772
